new_jobs.description:
Overview

Intrepid, an SPA Company, brings more than 20 years of experience supporting the Department of Defense and U.S. Government, consistently setting the standard for excellence in the federal marketplace. Committed to advancing the mission of the U.S. Warfighter, Intrepid leverages technological superiority to deliver innovative solutions across air, space, land, and sea domains. We are proud to foster a collaborative, dynamic work environment, offering competitive compensation and an industry-leading 401k contribution. Our team is built through merit and achievement, and we’re always looking for the best and brightest to join us in our growth. We treat our people like family, we are mission-focused, and we give back! Join us today.

Our Financial Management & Business Analysis Portfolio supports the U.S. Army Space and Missile Defense Command (USASMDC); the Office of the Assistant Secretary of the Army (ASA) Financial Management and Comptroller (FM&C); the U.S. Army Financial Management Command (USAFMCOM); the Defense Health Agency (DHA); and many other DoD customers.  We ensure the Army FM systems and processes are modernized and integrated to provide a complete range of financial and cost information needed for the Army to conduct business transactions, provide accountability to the public, and to support performance reporting and decision making.  We provide effective functional systems support, user technical support, training support, and governance support of the Army's modernized and deployed FM domain ERP systems (GFEBS / GFEBS-SA / GCSS-A (Finance)), ensuring technological capabilities maturation and evolution aligns with Army and FM domain goals and objectives. 

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst
to join our team to support the Defense Health Agency Chief Data and Analytics Office in building an enterprise data orchestration layer for the Military Health System. The team will be bringing together information from diverse defense and federal systems to build scalable data pipelines, APIs, and data products that improve how critical health data is integrated, accessed, and used. You will be expected to work with functional subject matter experts to elicit, clarify, translate, and document business requirements into technical requirements for engineers as well as helping to validate business requirements during development.

Responsibilities

Elicit and document data requirements from functional subject matter experts across clinical, operational, financial, and readiness domains.
Translate business questions into technical data requirements, including source-to-target mappings, business rules, transformation logic, and acceptance criteria.
Profile source systems directly using SQL to assess data availability, completeness, and fitness for the intended use before requirements are finalized.
Define data quality rules and validation criteria with the engineering team, and test delivered silver and gold datasets against them.
Build and maintain data dictionaries, business glossaries, data product documentation, and the metadata artifacts required for enterprise catalog registration.
Perform hands-on data analysis and technical validation, including writing transformation queries, building validation notebooks, and supporting light pipeline development in Databricks.
Support user acceptance testing and work directly with mission users to confirm data products meet their needs before release.
Write and refine user stories, maintain the requirements backlog, and participate in agile ceremonies with the pipeline and product teams.
Serve as the day-to-day bridge between Government functional owners, data stewards, and the technical delivery team.
Escalate data gaps, source system issues, and governance questions early, with a recommended path forward.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Possess an active Secret clearance
Master’s degree in Health Informatics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Public Health, or a related field
10+ years of business analysis, data analysis, or data product experience supporting analytics, reporting, or data integration work
Strong hands-on SQL skills. You must be able to independently write, debug, and optimize complex queries, including multi-table joins, aggregations, window functions, subqueries, and common table expressions.
Demonstrated experience translating business or mission requirements into technical data requirements, including source-to-target mappings and documented business rules
Experience profiling and validating data, identifying quality issues, and defining data quality and acceptance criteria
Working familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, and with how ETL and ELT pipelines are built and operated, sufficient to hold a credible conversation with engineers and to do independent analysis
Experience producing clear written artifacts such as requirements documents, data dictionaries, mapping specifications, and process documentation
Experience working in an agile delivery environment, including writing user stories and managing a requirements backlog
Strong communication skills, with the ability to elicit requirements from non-technical mission experts, translate them for technical teams, and reconcile differences between business intent and technical implementation.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, navigate ambiguity, and drive assigned work to resolution without close supervision
Working knowledge of relational and dimensional data modeling concepts, including keys, relationships, grain, normalization, and fact and dimension structures.

Desired Qualifications

Experience with Python (Pandas or PySpark preferred) for data profiling, validation, or light transformation work
Experience supporting DHA, the Military Health System, Defense Health Program, VA, or other federal healthcare data environments
Familiarity with health data standards and domains such as HL7 or FHIR, ICD-10, CPT, or claims and encounter data
Experience with Advana , the War Data Platform, Palantir Foundry, or similar DoW data environments
Experience with data governance artifacts and roles such as data stewardship, authoritative data sources, data cards, or metadata catalogs
Experience building or validating dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar tools
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GitLab, or comparable delivery and documentation tooling
Experience handling PHI and PII under HIPAA in a regulated environment

Pay Range Information

Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. About Banyan Cloud

Banyan Cloud is providing the next generation of Cybersecurity-as-a-Service, combining SOC operations, cloud security, On-Premises IT security, identity governance, data security, and compliance into a unified control plane.
Our platform enables organizations to move from alert-driven monitoring to automated, policy-driven security operations—leveraging SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and CNAPP capabilities.

About the Role

This is opening on our Information Security team, and the level you're brought in at depends on your experience:
0 – 2 years of relevant experience (including freshers with strong fundamentals)

Key Responsibilities

Monitor security alerts, logs, and dashboards (SIEM/SOC tooling) to identify and triage potential threats or anomalies.
Support vulnerability assessment and management — scanning, tracking, and following up on remediation with engineering teams.
Assist in security incident response: initial investigation, evidence collection, and documentation.
Help maintain and review security policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and playbooks.
Support internal and customer-facing security audits and compliance efforts (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
Assist with cloud security posture reviews across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, aligned with CSPM/KSPM/DSPM best practices.
Track and report on security metrics, open findings, and audit action items.
Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry security trends.

Additional Responsibilities

Own configuration, tuning, and health of SIEM/SOC tooling, alert rules, and detection use cases.
Lead incident response for moderate-severity incidents, including root cause analysis and remediation planning.
Design and implement security controls across cloud infrastructure, applications, and endpoints.
Partner with engineering teams on shift-left security — secure coding practices, IaC scanning, and secrets management.
Automate repetitive security tasks and reporting using scripting (e.g., Python, Bash).
Mentor and review the work of Information Security Analysts.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Solid understanding of core security concepts: networking fundamentals, OS security, encryption, authentication/authorization, and common attack techniques.
Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, or ISO 27001.
Basic exposure to SOC/SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, or the ELK stack) is a plus — hands-on SOC experience is not mandatory.
Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, and clear written communication for documenting findings and reports.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced, cloud-native security product environment.

Nice to Have

Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud security concepts.
Familiarity with containers/Kubernetes security.
Scripting/automation experience (Python, Bash, or similar).
Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, or CySA+ (or actively pursuing one).

Why Join Banyan Cloud

Work on a fast-growing, AI-powered cybersecurity platform used by enterprise customers across multiple industries.
Hands-on exposure to modern cloud security domains — CSPM, DSPM, KSPM, CIEM — alongside core SOC and infosec fundamentals.
Direct mentorship and a clear growth path from Analyst to Engineer and beyond.
Collaborative, security-first culture in a company built entirely around protecting cloud environments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are currently recruiting for the role of Senior Market Research Analyst to work with T&A’s Inward Investment/Market Entry team across India, Europe, North America & Middle East. The successful candidate will be responsible for understanding expansion plans of companies in India into International markets, engage in discussion with CXO, CFO level and support International Economic Development Agencies (EDAs & EDOs) towards attracting investments in their region.

ABOUT US

Incepted in India in 2006, T&A Consulting has become a reputable global consulting practice to government economic development agencies, businesses and academic institutions across Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas.

Headquartered in Gurgaon, with pan-India offices, T&A Consulting has a global footprint with representative offices in Europe, Middle East and a subsidiary in Toronto, Canada.

We work with various international investment attraction agencies where India is a key market and have been delivering a range of programs to identify outward investment opportunities from India.

Along our journey so far, we have competed against some of the world’s leading consulting and economic development brands and other boutique consulting practices to win the trust of new clients to develop and offer them ongoing support for their India market entry strategy, Investment attraction and Representation.

As a part of T&A, you will learn and grow with a highly collaborative and innovative team. We have nurtured a robust value system where talent meets integrity, clarity, and grit.

JOB DESCRIPTION

· The role of the Senior Research Analyst is to engage in discussions (telephonic interviews and one to one meeting at networking events) with CXOs of the shortlisted companies and develop an understanding of their expansion plans in various international markets.

· The shortlist of companies will be based on the comprehensive and in-depth research of the selected sectors and high growth companies within these sectors.

· Our target segment are companies who have a business interest to invest/expand in the international markets.

· The aim of this research and discussions is to uncover FDI opportunities for our clients i.e., Economic Development Organization (EDO) of selected countries, states, and regions.

· An FDI opportunity is defined as an India/Europe-based company, not already located in our client’s geography, and interested in setting up a legal entity, creating jobs and investing capital within a 12–24-month period.

RESPONSIBILITIES

· Interact with industry experts/ consultants via various modes of communication like telephonic interviews, participating in seminars/ networking events, meetings, and surveys to understand their expansion plans into international markets.

. Research and develop understanding different geographies and sectors.

· Present our client's geography as a potential business location for the company’s expansion plans.

· Analyze and formulate the reports from the data/information gathered from telephonic interviews.

· Participate in managing trade and investment delegation including setting up of meetings with CXO level executives of qualified companies.

· Prepare and deliver presentations on research findings to clients

· Interact with overseas clients and provide regular updates through the project.

EXPERIENCE

· Minimum 3 -4 years in an Expert Network Consulting/ KPO/ Knowledge Services, PE, VC with experience of researching industries and company profiles, speaking with industry experts/ C.E.O/C.X. O level executives.
· Experience of researching and profiling the companies is essential.
. Experience of outreach through various networking channels is a must.
· Exposure of handling international clients is a must.
· New Business Development experience.

WHAT DOES THIS ROLE OFFER?

· Exposure to a global consulting environment, with an opportunity to learn and grow in a meritocracy- driven organization
· Opportunity to work with team with broad experience of trade and investment promotion activities in India and overseas
· Opportunities for vertical and horizontal professional growth within a well-defined career progression path

new_jobs.description:
The position reports to: Head of Data Analytics

We are hiring a Senior Analyst to join our analytics team, reporting to the Head of Analytics. This role sits at the intersection of data modelling and business partnership — you'll own the design of clean, scalable models across our medallion architecture, while also being the go-to analytics partner for business stakeholders, guiding them on how to think about and measure their own problems. You'll work closely with the Head of Analytics on both fronts, and with Data Engineering to keep your models performant and reliable in production.

What You'll Do

Data Modeling
Design, build, and continuously improve data models across our medallion architecture — translating business questions into well-structured, scalable gold-layer datasets on Google GCP.
Own the modelling lifecycle from silver-layer cleaning and standardisation through gold-layer models ready for reporting, including dbt implementation, testing, and documentation.
Dig into source databases to reconcile data gaps, resolve inconsistencies across systems, and identify new metrics worth formalising into the model.
Partner with Data Engineering on bronze-layer ingestion and pipeline design, so your models are built on solid, well-understood inputs.

Business Partnership
Partner directly with business stakeholders to understand their goals and challenges, acting as their go-to person for anything analytics — from a quick SQL question to a new metric definition to a full dashboard.
Guide stakeholders on how to think about their own data: helping them frame the right question, choose the right metric, and understand tradeoffs in how something is calculated.
Build and maintain dashboards in Looker for self-service analytics, with a focus on usability so business users can find answers themselves.
Safeguard data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all reporting, proactively catching and resolving discrepancies before stakeholders do.

What We're Looking For

4 -5 years of relevant experience in analytics engineering, BI, or a similar analytics role.
Strong SQL skills with a solid understanding of data modeling within a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture.
Hands-on experience with a data modeling tool such as dbt/GCP dataform, for building and maintaining transformation workflows, including testing and documentation practices.
Experience with at least one BI tool (Looker preferred).
Excellent communication skills — able to listen closely, understand business problems, and explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Naturally curious and consultative — comfortable pushing back or offering a different angle when it serves the business better.
Problem-solver with sharp attention to detail and comfortable digging into unfamiliar databases to reverse-engineer business logic.

The mission of the DHS is to provide meaningful and equitable services, supports, and access to resources for District residents to realize their goals. The incumbent in this role is responsible for supervising, planning, administering, implementing, and monitoring contracts and human care agreements; as well as ensuring compliance with all terms and objectives in alignment with District procurement laws. Our approach to preventing homelessness and supporting individuals and/or families experiencing homelessness is focused both on systems-level reforms and on the quality of the programs and supports within that system. The Family Services Administration (FSA) helps individuals and families experiencing homelessness, people with low income, adults at-risk for abuse or neglect, teenage parents, families experiencing challenging times and refugees to become stable and fully self-sufficient through an array of social services, assessments and case-management and crisis-intervention.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager, Human Spaceflight and Satellites | Chef de projet, vols spatiaux habités et satellites
new_jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure
using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite
, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California
, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast recherche un(e) Chef de projet – Vols spatiaux habités et satellites
, rattaché(e) au Directeur des programmes européens et des ventes.

Ce poste consiste à piloter les activités de prospection, de réponse aux appels d’offres, de déploiement des campagnes commerciales et de suivi des programmes européens liés aux vols spatiaux habités et aux systèmes satellitaires.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement commercial, d’ingénierie et de gestion de mission du siège de Vast, le/la titulaire du poste assurera l’interface technique et programmatique entre les clients et partenaires européens et le site de Long Beach, en Californie.

Vast Europe est une équipe à taille humaine travaillant en étroite collaboration avec ses clients : agences spatiales, gouvernements, grands groupes industriels et clients privés à travers l’Europe. Le/la candidat(e) idéal(e) sera amené(e) à jongler entre la gestion des propositions, l’exécution des programmes, la coordination technique avec le siège et les échanges directs avec les clients, parfois au cours d’une même semaine.

Cette polyvalence est pleinement assumée, et nous recherchons une personne qui y voit un atout plutôt qu’une contrainte. Ce poste implique une collaboration étroite avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de gestion de mission, juridiques et financières du siège.

Il s’agit d’un poste à temps plein, en CDI, basé dans notre bureau de Paris, siège européen de Vast. Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

Principales responsabilités

Piloter la préparation et la gestion des propositions, offres et réponses aux appels d’offres institutionnels (notamment auprès de l’ESA, des agences spatiales nationales et des institutions européennes) ainsi que des opportunités commerciales, en coordonnant les contributions des équipes d’ingénierie, de gestion de mission, juridiques et financières du siège.
Assurer une veille active sur les programmes institutionnels européens, les cycles de financement et les opportunités d’approvisionnement pertinents pour Vast, et contribuer à la stratégie de conquête de marchés aux côtés du Directeur des programmes et des ventes européens.
Gérer les calendriers, livrables, jalons et la coordination interne des campagnes commerciales européennes et des programmes en phase de démarrage dans les domaines des vols spatiaux habités ( notamment les missions d’astronautes privés, Haven-1 et Haven-2) ainsi que des activités satellitaires.
Traduire les exigences des clients en données exploitables pour les équipes d’ingénierie et de gestion de mission du siège, et restituer aux clients les contraintes techniques et programmatiques de manière claire et structurée.
Préparer et tenir à jour les supports de présentation, descriptifs techniques et documentations de programme destinés aux interlocuteurs institutionnels et commerciaux européens.
Soutenir les réunions clients, les échanges techniques et les négociations avec les agences, maîtres d’œuvre et clients commerciaux, en intervenant le cas échéant en qualité d’ingénieur commercial, en pleine coordination avec les équipes de développement commercial basées aux États-Unis.
Représenter Vast lors de conférences européennes, journées sectorielles, événements organisés par les agences et autres rencontres relevant de l’écosystème spatial européen.
Assurer, selon les délégations reçues, l’intérim du Directeur des programmes et des ventes européens sur les sujets liés aux programmes et aux appels d’offres, et contribuer à l’intégration ainsi qu’au développement des membres juniors de l’équipe.
Apporter un soutien à l’équipe élargie de Vast Europe dans le cadre d’activités connexes, notamment en matière de relations institutionnelles et de développement de partenariats industriels, selon les priorités.

Profil requis

Diplôme de niveau licence ou supérieur en ingénierie, sciences, discipline technique, commerce ou domaine connexe.
Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en gestion de programmes, gestion d’appels d’offres et de soumissions, ou gestion de projets orientés client dans le secteur spatial ou aérospatial.
Expérience directe auprès de clients institutionnels européens et bonne connaissance des processus d’achat public et d’approvisionnement, notamment auprès de l’ESA, de l’Union européenne et/ou des agences spatiales nationales.
Expérience avérée comme interface principale entre un programme et un client externe, tant sur les aspects techniques que managériaux.
Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes.
Maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais indispensable. Maitrise du francais et/ou d’autres langues européennes fortement souhaitée.
Autorisation légale de travailler en France requise.

Compétences souhaitées

Diplôme de niveau master ou équivalent en ingénierie, sciences, commerce ou domaine connexe.
Maîtrise professionnelle du français ; la connaissance d’autres langues européennes constitue un atout.
Expérience des programmes ou missions de vols spatiaux habités, incluant une bonne connaissance des fournisseurs de véhicules habités et des campagnes d’intégration au lancement.
Expérience auprès de clients institutionnels et commerciaux.
Solides compétences en rédaction technique et en rédaction de propositions, notamment en matière de documentation d’interfaces multipartites et de programmes complexes.
Expérience dans un environnement de start-up ou de petite structure, avec la capacité de travailler de manière autonome lorsque nécessaire.
Solides compétences en négociation, priorisation et coordination interfonctionnelle, avec la capacité de s’adapter rapidement à des changements de cap stratégique.

Exigences supplémentaires

Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels fréquents, jusqu’à 50 % du temps, principalement en Europe et ponctuellement au siège de Vast à Long Beach, dans le respect des règles applicables relatives au temps de travail et aux temps de repos.

Titulaire d'un Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur, école de commerce ou équivalent), vous avez développé lors de votre parcours une bonne culture finance, et plus particulièrement en Private Equity. Modéliser les processus et rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles détaillées
Paramétrer et configurer la solution eFront Invest en lien avec les équipes techniques
Animer des ateliers utilisateurs et accompagner la conduite du changement
Piloter les phases de recette fonctionnelle et valider la conformité au besoin

Vous disposez d'un très bon niveau d'anglais, indispensable pour évoluer dans un environnement international.

D'un parcours d'intégration sur mesure, alliant e-learning, accompagnement managérial et certifications officielles eFront délivrées par BlackRock, reconnues sur le marché du Private Equity

D'une mutuelle nouvelle génération, performante et simple (Alan)

D'une carte titres restaurant Swile, pratique et avantageuse

new_jobs.title: Software Program Manager, New Product Introduction
new_jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID JR2024902

Job Category Program Manager

Time Type Full time

Do you want to join a team of motivated and experienced program managers who drive the successful introduction of NVIDIA's next generation GPU-based products? We work closely with internal leaders in Software, Hardware, Marketing and Operations to ensure the SW team delivers outstanding products while operating across multiple functional units and all levels of management to achieve Time-To-Market. As a part of the team, your knowledge of driver and firmware development processes and priorities will enable you to swiftly make the course adjustments needed to keep these complex projects on track!

Our team drives the correction of any issues that impede program success via on-the-spot corrections, and mid-program or post-mortem analysis. We closely collaborate to wring the maximum efficiency from our processes while seeking out process changes that improve both NPI and SW productivity. If you wish you were a catalyst in a company that is defining new, globally impactful markets, while working with sharp, upbeat peers, this is an opportunity for you!

What You’ll Be Doing

Negotiating all system, board, and chip needs on behalf of the SW development and QA teams.
Driving hardware allocation, infrastructure, budgeting, and priority calls.
Representing the Software organization at Go-To-Market meetings for the GPU segment.
Building and presenting a clear overview of the project plan.
Learning the software stack to understand SW team requirements.

What We Need To See

Hands-on experience with the software development lifecycle, specifically for device drivers and applications.
Experience in chip bringup.
Detail-oriented and comfortable multitasking in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities and changing requirements.
Excellent communication and technical presentation skills.
Thorough knowledge of software engineering and lifecycle principles.
Experience with productivity tools and process automation a huge plus, as well as data analysis with Excel or Tableau.
Knowledge of operating systems, graphics principles, AI datacenters, and standards a plus.
Experience using AI to boost productivity and solve problems.
3+ years in a similar or related role and BS CE, EE or CS (or equivalent experience)
PM certification/training a plus.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If you're creative, passionate, and self-motivated, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 108,000 USD - 184,000 USD for Level 2, and 136,000 USD - 212,750 USD for Level 3.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 6, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
